Your vechicle is supplied with oxygen for life support, fuel for maneuvering, and torpedoes for destruction of asteroids captured by the gravitational force of the black hole. The object of the game is simply to survive in orbit as long as possible. To refill your supplies of oxygen, fuel, and torpedoes, you must successfully rendezvous and dock with the Mother Ship. To preserve these vital supplies, you must protect the Mother Ship from destruction. 

MODES OF PLAY: The game can be played as a 3D projection, "Run 3D", or as a red-blue dual image projection requiring the use of red-blue 3D glasses, "Run Dual 30" Three modes of operation are provided called "Learn", "Play", and "Demo". In the Learn mode, you have unlimited oxygen, fuel, and torpedoes, and neither you nor the Mother Ship can be destroyed. The Learn mode allows you to practice maneuvering in orbit without being immediately destroyed.

Published in Berliner Spielekiste #43.

423182.overview: Choose your racing system: either national Hunt or Flat Racing type and you are free to enter course info, race details, create race analysis and print out analysis pages to take with you to the track surely you can't lose with the computing power of the future at your fingertips.

423194.overview: Set up your orbit parameters and try to keep your ship stable in space above the planet or moon! A freeware game by Lorenzo Zago created in 1991.

423408.overview: A 1994 homebrew game created by Paranoid Software involving atomic orbital mechanics.

423409.overview: A take on a single player Defender game as Shareware and made by Fred Bayer in 1992. Use the joystick to steer your fighter and to fire. For smartbomb press SPACE or the left mouse button. For hyperspace press the right mouse button or RE- TURN. Use the 'S' key to toggle sound off/on.  fast shoot'em up game based on Williams' Defender game.  Runs at 50/60 frames per second.  Includes PAL and NTSC versions.  Kickstart 2.04 compatible.  Requires 68020 CPU and 68881 FPU or better. Full version and/or source code available with shareware payment.

423525.overview: A new and beautiful version containing an expanded edition of the popular Amiga game Otík. A more graphically enhanced and complex mysterious story of revenge, the fight between good and evil, or an ordinary day for seventh grader Otí, from Crudesys in 2011.

423530.overview: The old game trope of the driving game where the point is staying safely in the middle of the procedurally generated road while avoiding baddies intent on taking your tires out from under you. This one created by Jean Pierre Software in 1994.

423542.overview: The continuation of the story of an adolescent boy, his journey for revenge set as a text adventure by Crudesys in 2011.

423549.overview: A mysterious story of revenge, the fight between good and evil, or an ordinary day for seventh grader Otík. An AMOS text adventure by Credesys from 2011.

423586.overview: A shareware game released in two versions, the full paid-shareware and a demo version. This is a text adventure created by Sue Medley in 1992 using the BIG Adventure Game Toolkit and published by the author and through Softworks. Sergent Oklib gets his revenge by sending you on a mission to retrieve the King's Staff, a powerful magic object. Basically, a greatly expanded version of the Staff of Power adventure.

423590.overview: An unreleased tech demo of a text adventure created by Panprase Studios in 2008 based on the ideas created on SHEEP in 1998 and coded partially at SHEEPU in response to the work of MisticJoe.

423596.overview: An Oil's Well style maze\collect-em up game released by Soft, Company X in 1990 and released 1992-10-02 on Amigo! issue 05/92. Extend your oil-mining robotic arm deep below the earth's crust to mine oil and line your pockets. But watch out for the monstrous bugs and other baddies that lie in wait for you -- one touch of them to the robotic arm and you lose a life!

423628.overview: Operacja Wąż Morski is an arcade naval battle game. During an operation called Sea Serpent a submarine ship ran into enemy ships. The player's task is piercing through the ranks of the enemy by shooting down the ships sailing from the left and right side of the screen. Ships sail in four rows, for each sunken ship the player receives between ten to forty points, depending on the distance. Sinking of the Red Cross ship costs fifty points. Points indicator shows how many points are needed for the next wave. After each six fired missiles the cannon must be reloaded.

423633.overview: Finding the story offers the child several sequences of events. Each sequence involves three images, which he must manipulate in order to put them in the proper chronological order. Several levels and game play modes are offered in relation to the child's age and progress. This game was released in Europe, published by Carraz Editions in 1989.

423688.overview: An AMOS based freeware game that was never finished and still not fully functioning, created by Retro1234 in 2016.

423724.overview: Ortotris is a Tetris variant. The game takes place in the same manner except that the player does not stack bricks but Polish words. The player's task is to choose the correct spelling. The correct spelling indicated at the bottom of the screen needs to be selected from different choices by using the left or right cursor keys. The game highlights a part of the word the player needs to decide on. If correct, the selection is deleted, if not, it remains. On the right side of the screen displays the percentage of correctness of the answers. The game ends with the degree of exposure.The game has a mode of practice and theory of all types of polish spelling. The Amiga version of the game includes the Ortowpis editor, which allows players to add new words to the dictionary.

424044.overview: A Polish language set of 4 games constructed taking into account all spelling rules (a game of 10,000 words). this game published by Alderan S.C. in 1992.

424700.overview: A Swedish language educational game focused on Mathematics created by Erik Gustafsson and published by SPAB and M-E Soft in 1990.

442410.overview:
The Oregon Trail is a 2040 mile east-west, wagon route and you are about to take the task with your family in 5-6 months and seek to colonize in Oregon, year 1847.
You will need to ration food, hunt, trade, and ford rivers while prioritizing your family's survival.

449316.overview: The Rangers Football Game is a puzzle and trivia game about the Glaswegian football club. The puzzle consists of a number of tiles, each part of a picture, and the player has to swap the tiles to recreate the picture. However to make any swaps it's necessary to earn moves which is done by answering questions. The questions all deal with Rangers history and the player has to choose one of four alternatives before time runs out. The quicker the player answers the more moves will become available on the puzzle board. A help button exist and when clicked it autoperforms a move on the board.

450067.overview:
Licensed edutainment software title based on the Mad Libs children's books, written by Roger Price & Leonard Stern and printed by then-publisher Price Stern Sloan. Distributed in the U.S. by Electronic Arts. Computer MAD LIBS is an exciting new version of the MAD LIBS game you already love to play! New twists and surprises await you as computer technology is applied to the "World's Greatest Party Game." The eight MAD LIB stories on the computer disk utilize a revolutionary, built-in speech technology that allows you to hear your stories with hilarious results. Each story is illustrated with delightful cartoon graphics that add to the fun! You can edit and save any MAD LIB you create and hear it as many times as you like! Get ready for hours of fun! 
 

MAIN MENU CHOICES
MAD LIB Titles: Select this Main Menu option, and you will see the titles of the MAD LIB stories on this disk. Click on the MAD LIB title of your choice and get ready to play!
Mystery MAD LIBS: Select Mystery MAD LIBS and you are ready to play, but in this case you have no idea what the story is about. Get ready for some surprising results!
Library: Make this selection, and you will be able to choose a title from a list of all the MAD LIB stories you have saved on your disk.
Quit: Select Quit when you are finished playing MAD LIBS

450225.overview:
An unofficial conversion of the 1981 Nintendo Game & Watch game of the same name for the Commodore Amiga.

It was developed by Solstice and released into the public domain in 1992.

455748.overview: Impact Armor Alpha is an old school mecha platform game from the snes, megadrive era, like Assault Suits Valken (Cybernator), Front Mission:Gun Hazard and Ranger-X.

455905.overview:
Octothello is based on the Reversi game, but on an eight-sided board. Reversi, also known as Othello, is a classic board game for two players. In this version you play against the Amiga computer. While playing, click the left mouse button to make a move, or use the right button for menus.

You are either black or white, and the goal is to fill the board with as many bricks of your own color as possible. By trapping the opponents bricks in between two of your own, they turn into your own color. The Amiga plays a very mean game, so the difficulty level in this version can be considered moderate to high. If you believe the author, it was the strongest commercially Othello of its time.

459309.overview: An optimized port of SEGA's 1986 arcade game OutRun, utilizing the original 68000 assembly code, to mid-spec Commodore Amiga computers.

459895.overview: OpenDUNE is an open source re-creation of the popular game "Dune II",originally made by Westwood Studios, and released by Virgin Entertainment. It attempts to re-create the original game and apply modern technology to it to allow it to be run natively on most operating systems.

461912.overview:
Othello is the Amiga version of the famous strategy game Reversi.

In this game, the two players (the computer and the human player) take turns placing their own pieces—distinguished from the opponent's by color—on the board.

A piece can only be placed if there are opponent's pieces situated between it and another piece of the same color; those opponent's pieces are then flipped to match the color of the player who made the move.

The two players must therefore try to have as many pieces of their own color on the board as possible and position their pieces to prevent any damaging attacks from the opponent.

When the board is completely filled, the player with the greatest number of pieces wins.

Published in the April 1990 issue of AmigaMagazine OnDisk #11.

462488.overview: Playable demo of Outrun AGA for Amiga40 October 2025.

470079.overview: Osiris is under attack. Unknown forces have infiltrated the network, leaving control nodes scattered throughout the system.

470698.overview: Your callsign is A500. You are given a state-of-the-art spacecraft equipped  with electronic systems ATARI could only ever dream of.  Your mission  is to set  course for  the galaxy that houses the main stronghold of the Atari forces and wipe them out completely. We wish you the very best of luck on this cosmic mission.

472901.overview: The game is a personal reinterpretation of the Chrome Dino game, mixed with a strong dose of inspiration from the classic SEGA arcade masterpiece OutRun.

480157.overview: A native port of OpenTTD 1.0.5 to classic AmigaOS 3.x on 68k, with its own video driver written against Intuition and graphics.library. No SDL, and no RTG card required — it runs on plain AGA, and on OCS/ECS too.

480193.overview:
Unfinished 3D dungeon crawler in AMOS, playable ADF
Oracle was originally developed in AMOS Professional beginning in 1996. The last known historical beta is version 0.3d, dated  13 December 1996.

480368.overview: AmiXcom is a native AmigaOS 3.x port of OpenXcom — the open source reimplementation of X-COM: UFO Defense and X-COM: Terror from the Deep — for real classic hardware: 68020+ without FPU, AGA chipset. Not PiStorm-, Vampire- or Emu68-only. No SDL: the SDL 1.2 API the game expects is a small shim (native/sdlmini/) on top of a bare-metal Amiga graphics/audio layer.

481647.overview:
A free update to a classic Amiga era game.

Features:
    Runs from a single, standard floppy disk (or ADF)
    Compatible with all 680x0 CPUs
    Graphics, sound and timing bugs fixed for fast machines/emulators
    Highscores saved if you write enable the disk

The original of this game is incredibly rare, and the only previously available crack has problems (e.g. no highscore save, dodgy 2-disk swap) so this release adds all the fixes from my WHDLoad patch, and uses the much nicer Rob Northen trackdisk loader.
Although the original used a custom longtrack disk format, the amount of data was actually less than a standard disk. With some careful arrangement I was able to condense everything to fit.
Trainers are included for infinite lives and level skip, as well as a starting level select.

481967.overview: A simple shooter for Amiga 500 (512k) or Amiga 1000 (with 1050 expansion) modeled after old arcade game Pleiads (one of my favorites when I was a kid). It is still too easy in the current state, I will improve it further in the future. The game is completely free.

481981.overview:
Out Run 2026 - Amiga's Port of Mega Drive Classic

Hit the open road in this new Amiga conversion of the Mega Drive port. Race against the clock, choose your route, and enjoy sun-soaked scenery with a soundtrack made for the journey.

If U.S. Gold’s original Amiga conversion left you disappointed, this project takes a fresh approach. Built from the Mega Drive version, it aims to deliver a more satisfying driving experience and bring more of the game’s character to the Amiga.

482123.overview: Sensible World of Soccer, rebuilt. OpenSWOS is the original Amiga game rewritten in C, so the same game runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, the Raspberry Pi and the Amiga itself.

482172.overview: One case. One order. A country that must not see you.

482894.overview: One Must Fall 2097 - widely regarded as the best DOS fighting game bring it's mech-based battles to the Amiga!

482904.overview: Your treasure only becomes cash when you bring it back to the surface. Bring all three blue diamonds home and sell them at the surface bay to unlock the animated reward. Separate hauls count towards this objective. Then choose ONE MORE HAUL to continue exploring the same mine, or END to finish your expedition.
